finding: Contact order is spark and hit sound at contact, then a shared freeze (attacker pausetime[0], target pausetime[1]), then flash and rumble, then a knock slide with x velocity x0.6 after slideTime.
Target freeze is assigned only when the target is not already in hit-stun (char.go 14316-14317), so stacked hits do not add freezes. Keep this for three-on-one.
Screen shake is one shared EnvShake object per screen; defaults freq 60, ampl -4, mul 1.0; fallEnvShake fires in the ground-bounce states (common1.cns.zss 746, 796).
Three-frame near-white flash (palFx add 128,128,128) in the airborne get-hit and air recovery states; 20-frame red flash for guard break (guardbreak.zss 163).
Rumble (forceFeedback) by hit tier: 6, 8 and 15 frames (common1.cns.zss 504 and the 5010-5030 group). Phone haptics analogue, heavy tier only.
Tuned numbers are absent: character packs are not in the repo, so per-move hit values cannot be read here (half read: engine plus common scripts).
Hit order in the engine: contact flash, attacker pause only if not already paused or airborne (openbor.c 31722), target pause always added (31736-31742), hit sound last (31931).
Hit-sound pitch curve: playback speed = 100 - (attack_force - 5), clamped 60 to 100, or fixed at 100 with noslowfx (openbor.c 31956-32006). Damage makes the sound lower.
Target pause stacks because it is always added, so three attackers freeze the target three times. Do not copy; cap and take max.
Freeze time has two script forms with different units: a raw int (openbor.c 19792) and a float times game_speed (20027, 20152). Pick one unit in our schema.
Screen shake: bounce sets a fixed 4 px quake (openbor.c 32381) unless disabled; a frame quake (quakeframe framestart, repeat, v) is per animation (openbor.h 2546-2552).
Engine half only; the module data pack is absent (media/ holds only _DUMMY), so no real per-move hit values exist in this repo.
